item.description:
AppleNugs 1.2

The Dashboard gets a real player. The inspector's now-playing section is now a per-theme miniplayer instead of a text block:

  • Tape Room — a Compact Cassette at true 25:16: your cover shows through the shell window behind two reels whose tape packs actually trade size as the track runs, the exposed tape span is the scrubber, and the write-on label carries the track, artist, and show.
  • The Receiver — a tuner faceplate with live L/R VU meters, a RECEIVING lamp, and machined transport buttons.
  • Click Wheel — a monochrome track card over a compact dial.
  • Soundboard & Shoebox — a token-driven compact player with cover chip, scrubber, and transport (filled vs. keyline personality).

Every variant scrubs, shows elapsed/remaining time, and keeps prev/play/next a click away. The inspector column now sits at 340–380pt so the show line fits.

Fixes: cassette reel hubs now show their splines, so you can see them turn (and freeze in place on pause).
